description: A recoverable, supervised agent workflow that validates a mobile app idea with attributable evidence, then turns it into a designed, verified, device-proven, store-ready Expo and React Native project on a production foundation.

pipeline.output: A human-chosen raw idea or existing spec path
Claude Design prototype and design/<slug>/ implementation contract
Implemented Expo and React Native app
Doctor, lint, TypeScript, test, and production-export results
system-runs/<slug>/device-proof/report.md with target classification, a linked run log, and a SHA-256 artifact inventory

humanGates: Review fresh validation evidence and approve the idea; WEAK requires an explicit risk override
Approve the Claude Design prototype and implementation contract before Setup or Build
Approve any production build or store submission

skills.name: ship-system
skills.job: Coordinate the supervised end-to-end app pipeline and its paper trail

skills.name: validate-idea
skills.job: Validate an app idea against fresh, attributable market, competitor, trend, policy, and feasibility evidence

skills.name: create-spec
skills.job: Turn an approved validation report into an honest app spec
inputs: Approved validation report, or a raw idea that remains UNVALIDATED

skills.name: design-screens
skills.job: Create a synced interactive Claude Design prototype and implementation contract before code

skills.name: setup-ship-rn
skills.job: Configure the app identity, foundation, backend, features, and branding

skills.name: build-idea
skills.job: Implement an approved idea spec and design pack on the foundation
outputs: App routes, components, stores, translations, and metadata

skills.name: add-ai-service
skills.job: Add an AI capability across both supported backend modes

skills.name: add-paywall
skills.job: Configure RevenueCat products, premium gates, and review-safe paywalls

skills.name: verify-on-device
skills.job: Author and run Maestro E2E flows, then capture explicitly classified simulator or physical-device evidence
outputs: Optional physical-device MP4, screenshots, logs, and .ad replay, linked and hashed by the report when real-device-passed

skills.name: prepare-store-submission
skills.job: Prepare store metadata, assets, compliance, builds, and review checks

skills.name: validate-skills
skills.job: Validate skill metadata, manifest references, and pipeline agreement

skills.name: react-native-best-practices
skills.job: Guide React Native performance and architecture work
inputs: React Native problem or optimization target

skills.name: upgrading-react-native
skills.job: Upgrade React Native or Expo with compatibility checks
inputs: Current and target React Native or Expo versions

skills.name: github
skills.job: Handle GitHub branches, commits, and pull request workflows
outputs: GitHub branch, commit, or pull request result
